eval.displayName: DNA sequence design for Transcription Factor binding
aliases: DNA sequence design for transcription factor binding
eval.description: OpenAI DNA design eval: the model edits or proposes sequences to raise predicted binding for known transcription factors, starting from random DNA prompts drawn from Nucleobench-style settings. Oracle models score affinity; headline metrics are pass@1 and win rate versus a gradient baseline (Ledidi). Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how well the model designs DNA sequences that bind strongly to specific transcription factors.

links.title: GPT-Rosalind-5.5 system card (DNA sequence design for Transcription Factor binding)

versions.changes: Cards cite 11 transcription factors with 50 prompts each; oracle scoring versus Ledidi win-rate threshold.

scores.description: Oracle affinity for the model design beats the Ledidi gradient baseline on that prompt.

metrics.description: Share of prompts where the model beats Ledidi (reported as pass@1 or win rate).
